categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies test/functional/p2p_eviction.py, which tests peer connection eviction and protection rules.
categories.rationale: Fixes a false positive in peer eviction testing to ensure block-time protection is actually tested. The author showed that on master, 'deleting the line where the peers send their block... allows the test to pass anyway' because connection-time fallback protects the same peers, masking potential regressions.
